narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: Flash flooding was reported along Centerville Turnpike. Flash flooding was also reported along Battlefield Boulevard.
Marlborough Drive was covered in water.
Yard and basement flooding was reported.
